urdu.name: اصلاح
urdu.long_meaning: Islah (اصلاح) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم اصلاح، درستی، سدھار ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

arabic.name: إصلاح
arabic.long_meaning: Islah (إصلاح) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي الإصلاح، التقويم، التسوية. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.

faq.a: Islah is associated with the Arabic form إصلاح, whose core sense is reform, correction, setting right.

faq.q: What is the origin of Islah?
faq.a: Islah is associated with Arabic. Islah is Arabic إِصْلَاح (Iṣlāḥ) 'reform, correction, setting right', from the root ص ل ح (ṣ-l-ḥ). The source gloss 'To make right or correct' is consistent.
Yes — the underlying form إصلاح is Arabic.
Islah can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Islah should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. False

faq.q: What does Islah mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Islah is rendered اصلاح and carries the sense اصلاح، درستی، سدھار.

faq.q: What does Islah mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Islah is rendered اصلاح and carries the sense اصلاح، درستی، بهسازی.
A romanized syllable approximation is is-lah. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Islah?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Islah, islah. Script forms are إصلاح, اصلاح, इसलाह.

faq.q: Is Islah a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
